findings.title: Attacks 29 and 45: on /embed/<id> links drawn inside a tool keep the browser's default link colour (#0000EE), 1.99 to 1 on the dark page
findings.location: site/src/pages/embed/[tool].astro:16 imports only base.css, not the global rules of site/src/layouts/Base.astro:91-97 (a { color: var(--text) }; a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible ring). Links that rely on those rules: site/src/components/atlas/AtlasPicker.svelte:87 (the 'chosen' link has no colour) and site/src/components/tools/t15/FateReport.svelte:57 (the GSS12 source link; also the unverified-mark of t15/fate.ts:143 in preview builds)
findings.claim: The link colour and the focus ring of links and buttons are set only by Base.astro's global style. The embed route does not use that layout, so every link a tool draws is #0000EE (visited #551A8B) in both themes, below A-6 in the dark theme. Buttons without their own :focus-visible rule fall back to the browser ring there.
findings.expected: SPEC 7.5 A-6: text at least 4.5 to 1 in light and dark themes; 7.4: /embed/<tool> renders the tool alone, with the same tool as /tools/<tool> (whose links are drawn in var(--text), 15.3 to 1 on #121212).
findings.observed: Dark theme, 360 x 800. /embed/atlas/?g=E8: 'Open the Atlas page of E8' has color rgb(0, 0, 238) on rgb(18, 18, 18), ratio 1.99. /embed/affine/ after the pentagon tab and Play on, both by keys: '[GSS12] Theorem 1.2, with the signs reversed' is rgb(0, 0, 238), ratio 1.99. The control /tools/atlas/?g=E8 shows the same link in rgb(232, 232, 232). Also, a Tab walk of /embed/garden in the dark theme shows its jump buttons with 'auto 1px' (the browser ring) instead of 3px solid --focus-ring, as on /tools/garden.
findings.reproduction: From a clean checkout of f07eec6 plus the reproducer: npm ci; npm run build; npx playwright test site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-05-p6-embed-link-contrast.spec.ts (webServer = astro preview). The two embed tests fail as above and the /tools control passes.
findings.specRef: SPEC.md 7.5 A-6 ('Text and numerals at least 4.5 to 1 ... in light and dark themes') and A-2; 7.4 'Embedding'; CONTRACTS 8 (tokens in both themes)
findings.proposedFix: Move the global link colour and the a/button :focus-visible rule from Base.astro's <style is:global> into styles/base.css, which both Base.astro and the embed page import. Alternatively import the same rule in pages/embed/[tool].astro. Add the dark-theme link check to embed.spec.ts.

findings.title: Attacks 9, 33, 34 and 39: while a prediction is pending, the 'Show as table' view of T13 (M9 b6, b7) and T9 (M1 b5) overflows at 320 with no tab stop, so its right-hand columns cannot be reached by keyboard (axe scrollable-region-focusable, serious)
findings.location: site/src/components/board/ToolFrame.svelte:263-268 and :339-345 (fieldset.bare is overflow-x: auto with no tabindex, role or name); site/src/components/tools/T13SatakeStudio.svelte:901 and :935 (table buttons disabled={!api.hydrated || frozen}); T09Kostant's table buttons, disabled likewise while frozen
findings.claim: The table view's scroll box relies on the buttons inside it for keyboard access. A frozen tool renders all those buttons with the HTML disabled attribute, so at 320 the box scrolls but nothing in it can take focus. T13's tables are 370 px wide in a 288 px box, so its Population, Coordinate and Composite move columns are out of keyboard reach until the prediction is answered.
findings.expected: A-10: the table view presents the same state at any time. A-11: what cannot reflow scrolls inside its own box, and that box is keyboard-operable (A-1, WCAG 2.1.1). 7.7: no serious axe violation. The frozen boards themselves stay focusable with aria-disabled (Board.svelte header), and the table view should follow the same rule.
findings.observed: 320 x 800, prediction pending, table view opened by keys. M9 b6: box scrollWidth 370, clientWidth 288, box tabindex none, 0 focusable elements inside; M9 b7: the same. M1 b5 (kostant): 306 in 288, 0 focusable. axe (scrollable-region-focusable, serious) flags 'details[open=""] > .bare' in each. After 'Show me' the buttons are enabled and the box becomes reachable. M3 b8 (kostant, frozen) shows the same in the reflow sweep.
findings.reproduction: npm ci; npm run build; npx playwright test site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-05-p6-frozen-table-scroll.spec.ts (3 failed: b6, b7 and M1 b5; each message gives the box size and the focusable count, and the soft axe check lists the serious violation).
findings.specRef: SPEC.md 7.5 A-10, A-11, A-1; 4.0 Predict ('The board is frozen until ...'); 7.7 Accessibility row; WCAG 2.1.1
findings.proposedFix: Give ToolFrame's table-view box a tab stop and a name (tabindex=0, role=region, aria-label 'Table of <title>'), as the site does for its other scroll boxes. Or keep frozen table buttons focusable with aria-disabled='true', as Board.svelte does.

findings.title: Attacks 30 and 33: T13's table view writes negative populations with the ASCII hyphen-minus ('-1') while the board and every other T13 panel use U+2212

findings.expected: SPEC 6.3: 'The value is the signed integer, set in tabular figures, with a true minus sign.' A-10: the table presents the same state as the board. The board draws '−1', the Play θ panel prints '(−1, −1, −1)', and the restricted table's Coordinate column uses intText.
findings.observed: /tools/satake/?g=A3&x=1.3&t=1.2.3 after Play θ by keys: the board numerals are ['−1', '−1', '−1'] and the table Population column is ['-1', '-1', '-1'].

findings.claim: M9 is the first lesson whose predictions have negative answers. Predict composes both the visible result and the live-region sentence from raw numbers, so the reader hears and sees '-1'. The lesson's reveal in the same sentence prints '(0, −1)'.
findings.expected: A-4: negative numbers spoken as 'minus' in the tool's announcements; CONTRACTS 4 speak; 6.3: true minus sign on screen.
findings.observed: /modules/m9-real-forms/ b6, 'Show me' by Enter. data-out=predictResult reads 'The answer is (-1, -1, 0).' The live region reads 'Shown. The answer is (-1, -1, 0). Mutating city 2 turns (1, 0, 0) into (1, 1, 0), ...'. On b7 the region reads 'Shown. The answer is (-1, -1). ... node 2 gives (0, −1), ...', mixing both signs in one sentence.
findings.reproduction: npm ci; npm run build; npx playwright test site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-05-p6-predict-answer-minus.spec.ts (1 failed; the soft check reports the result line and the hard check the announcement).

findings.location: site/src/content/modules/m9-real-forms.mdx:129 (b2 caption 'of w_X'), :150 (b3 caption 'dim k = '), :183 (b6 question 'the word of w_X', caption 'dim k = ..., dim p = ...')

For RT-06 (hydration boundary): before M9 b8 hydrates (client:visible), or without JavaScript, the T13 catalogue table is a horizontal scroll box (T13SatakeStudio.svelte .panel .table, overflow-x auto, 473 in 320) whose only focusables, the Load buttons, are disabled. After hydration the Load buttons make it reachable, which is why the gate scan (after hydration, at 360) passes. The same pattern without the frozen state is P6-RT-05-02's cause.

Dark theme semantics (not a finding; MERGE ruling (1) on P6-A3): black nodes are filled with --text (#E8E8E8, a light disc) and white nodes with --page (#121212, a dark disc with a light ring). So in the dark theme a 'black' node looks white-filled and a 'white' node looks dark. The filled-versus-hollow reading holds, and the name says 'black'.

The 'holds' lamp of T13 is a disc filled with the Populations accent #009E73, and M9 names the state by colour: b4 caption 'the three lights are green'; b10 challenge 'find the τ that turns all three lights green'. 8.3 lists the accents' uses as panel borders, icons and the two words' underlines. The edge palette also reuses #009E73, and SPEC 4 T13 itself speaks of red lights, so this is left as a note. The lights carry the words holds and fails plus a disc or cross shape (A-5 met).

T13's game board names its nodes 'City 2, population minus 1, mutation would change nothing' with data-can-act=false, and Enter announces 'The game board moves by the stages of θ and by the composite moves.' The A-3 mutation state phrase is not a can-act phrase, so this is consistent with the templates but may surprise a screen-reader user (plan reading).

Predict's position fields on M9 are labelled 'Node 1', 'Node 2', ... Labels come from Predict.svelte and the board's labels: b6 asks for populations (cities) and b7 for restricted-board coordinates, which are not the E6 nodes 1 and 2. Wording note; the component is from phase 1.

Attack 43: each /embed/<id> page has the same <title> as /tools/<id> (16 pairs, e.g. 'Satake Studio'). WCAG 2.4.2 needs a descriptive title, not a distinct one, so this is a note. lang, viewport, a single <main> and the skip link to #main hold on all 90 routes (static scan of site/dist).
Atlas real-form links all read 'Open this real form in the Satake Studio' (four on B3). Their purpose is clear in the context of the list item (2.4.4 AA); 2.4.9 (AAA) would want distinct text.

The Chromium auto focus ring is used, not the site's 3px --focus-ring, on T2's chart-box and T5's tape scrollbox, on /tools and /embed alike (pre-existing, phase 1 and 3). It is visible as a thin light or dark two-tone ring.

The P6-A5 repair holds: Export LaTeX announces 'Downloaded <tool>-<board>.tex.' or 'nothing to export as LaTeX' (T15 and T16 default states) through the tool's region. The notice text has no capital and no full stop (wording).
